notes.title: 1 Year Anniversary! 20% Sale + Mobile Release!✨
notes.notes:
[b]Celebrate our first anniversary of Diets & Deities with us![/b] A huge thank you to our loyal supporters and a warm welcome to all our new players joining the adventure. ❤️

One year has flown by and we're so proud of our journey and we look forward to the adventures ahead. We're also thrilled to announce that Diets & Deities is [b]now available on Android.[/b] And don't worry, iOS fans—your version is coming soon!

Check us out on [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.LarrikinInteractive.DietsandDeities&pli=1]Google Play[/url]!

Diets & Deities is an upcoming rhythm cooking game developed by Larrikin Interactive, an indie studio based in Northern Territory, Australia. Discover the music and recipes from diverse cultures as you dodge to the beat and uncover the flavours of the universe. 

[previewyoutube=Uv-5N7sL8Qc;full][/previewyoutube]

You play as Nephele, the first (and potentially last) deity created in a millennia and it's up to you to dance and dodge your way through forgotten cultures, move to the beat, and eat your weight in long-lost dishes.

Each area, including its music and deity, is directly inspired by our team's backgrounds: Australian (with First Nations creatives), Balinese, Brazillian, and Chinese. Nephele unlocks real recipes the players can cook at home, all curated by the team from our local markets to childhood favourites. 

----------------------------

notes.title: Cultural Consent in Diets & Deities
notes.notes:
We presented a talk at [url=https://www.apraamcos.com.au/about/supporting-the-industry/programs/high-score]High Score[/url], a convention for music and audio in games! We discussed cultural consent while creating Diets & Deities with our composer, Kuya James, and our cultural consultant and friend, Ben Tyler! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43801174/d2239fc03b137f483199317c0e85ca082534b106.jpg[/img]

It was such a great opportunity to share our experience working with different cultures and we hope we inspired other game devs to approach different cultures in their work in healthy and creative ways! 

[b]And a huge thank you to APRA AMCOS for another amazing year at High Score!  🎉 ✨[/b]

notes.title: Diets & Deities is OUT NOW! 🎉✨
notes.notes:
[b]Diets & Deities is officially out now on Steam! [/b]  

Diets & Deities is a rhythm cooking game where you play as Nephele, the first (and potentially last) deity created in a millennia and it's up to you to dance and dodge your way through forgotten cultures, move to the beat, and eat your weight in long-lost dishes. Discover the music and recipes from diverse cultures as you dodge to the beat and uncover the flavours of the universe. 

You can experience: 
- [b]Diverse areas and characters[/b] inspired by cultures shared by the team: Australia (with First Nations creatives), Bali, Brazil, and China
- [b]Locally composed and produced music[/b] with authentic cultural instruments, sounds, and beats
- [b]Wholesome and non-competitive rhythm gameplay[/b] that focuses on an audio-visual experience and satisfaction over perfection
- [b]Real recipes[/b] inspired by each culture for players to unlock and cook at home
- Environments, characters, and music working in rhythmic harmony to create a [b]cultural and culinary experience[/b] worth bopping along to!

We're so excited to finally share our game with you and would love to hear your thoughts! If you'd like to give us feedback or just chat about your favourite dishes, can join our [b][url=https://discord.gg/jFarKAq8fc]Discord Community[/url][/b]!

notes.title: 2023 Recap
notes.notes:
[b]Happy New Year![/b] I hope you had a lovely holiday break! We've been working on something super special [i](keep an eye out for another update later this month 👀)[/i]

[b]A lot happened in 2023 for both Diets & Deities and the Northern Territory (our hometown!) game development scene, so I thought it'd be fun to do some reflecting today![/b] At the beginning of the year, we were redesigning and improving our entire gameplay system, designed each cultural deity and their lands, and most importantly reached you!

[h3]Here's a quick recap:[/h3]
[list][*] Got [b]Screen Australia[/b] and [b]Screen Territory[/b] funding!
[*] Attended [b]GDC[/b] and showcased game at [b]IGEA's Australian Reception[/b]
[*] Joined our NT game dev crew at [b]GCAP[/b] in Melbourne (from 3 of us in 2022 to 13 last year!)
[*] Our studio director, Dylan, won [b]The Empower Award[/b] at the AGDAs!
[*] Presented the game at [b]PAX Aus[/b] (first time for the NT)![/list]
This was my first year delving into marketing as a full-time role and although it's been scary and hard to do for the first time solo, I've learned so much! If you have any feedback or advice for me, I'd love to hear it! ❤️ [b]Here's a lil snapshot on how Diets & Deities changed over 2023! [/b]As the concept artist, it's crazy to see the original landscapes I helped design.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43801174/c1b1dd8d00ddd2921b1014808fa7e226c9202c2c.gif[/img]

I also made a TikTok with all of our moments from 2023! Check it out [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@dietsanddeities][b]here[/b][/url]!

We've come a long way since we started development in April 2022 (how has it been so long...) [b]We're a team of 12 people, most of us being first-time game devs, so we're really proud of what we've achieved so far![/b] Although our journey isn't over yet, thank you so much for your support!

That's it from me! I'm very excited for what the future holds and I hope you're keen to be part of it~Feel free to reply to these emails or message me in our Discord server (@Skye)!

notes.title: #6 - Demo on Itch.io! 🙌✨
notes.notes:
Hi, Skye here! I'm the concept artist and marketing peep for Diets & Deities, our multicultural rhythm cooking game!

We actually got the idea for our gameplay from Everhood because I loved their rhythm battle style. Weaving between colourful notes and listening to really catchy beats was so much fun~ So I wanted our game to have the same unique audio-visual experience but with our own wholesome and cultural twist! Have you been playing anything recently that got you super inspired?

[h2]So...we put a demo on Itch?![/h2]
[b]Yep! I’m so excited to announce that we have our very first demo up on [url=https://larrikininteractive.itch.io/dietsanddeities]Itch.io[/url]!🎉
[/b] If you’ve already played our game before (like at PAX or TROPiCON!), we’ve made quality-of-life improvements based on your amazing feedback!

[b]So what’s new?[/b] Players can now move smoothly to the beat! Player input is not restricted but you’re incentivised to move in time with the beat to absorb echoes (collectible notes) without getting hit by the corruption spikes (avoidable notes).

After lots of play-testing with the team, we really feel like the player is more in sync with the tracks now! I’ve definitely had a lot of fun restarting levels to try and get that perfect no-hit run ;3

[b]Wait, what’s happening with BETA testing? [/b]Everyone who previously signed up will be added to our new special Beta Tester role on Discord to message directly into our BETA channels! As we get feedback from this demo, we’ll be working closely with our playtesters and have a BETA released via Steam.

[b]The demo is available for everyone, but if BETA testing is something you’re interested in, join the server and message me (@Skye)! [/b]

Here's what the game looked like at PAX vs now! The changes might seem subtle, but we worked really hard to improve the player experience~

[b]Check it out[url=https://larrikininteractive.itch.io/dietsanddeities] here! [/url][/b]

I'd love to chat and see what you liked about the demo, where we can improve, and most importantly...who is best girl in Diets & Deities?? 😳❤️ Oh but before I go...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43801174/45993b02bc5b33678d0df9366e3741245bdce299.png[/img]
[b]Here's a word from Caipora, our fiery and feisty Brazillian deity🔥
[/b]
[i]Oi you, the Gammon Bros scolded me for not getting you a recipe earlier. So I burned their hair (or is it just leaves??) to a crisp, that might teach 'em... Anyway, whenever I'm feeling a little hot-headed, I always make this dish. 
[/i]
Enjoy,
Caipora❤️‍🔥

[h3]- Acai Bowl - [/h3]
[b]Ingredients:[/b]
20[list]
[*] 200g (2 packets) frozen acai puree, broken into pieces
[*] 1 frozen banana, sliced
[*] 1 cup frozen mixed berries
[*] 1 cup milk (dairy, soy, oat, etc.) or coconut water
[*] Assorted toppings (optional): fresh sliced fruit, granola, coconut flakes, chia seeds, cacao nibs, etc.[/list]
[b]Method:[/b]
Place all ingredients together in a blender[olist]
[*]  and blend until smooth. Add more milk or coconut water when needed for desired consistency or texture.
[*] Assemble by dividing into bowls and adding desired toppings. Best enjoyed immediately.[/olist]
[b]Did you know you can unlock recipes after completing each level? Here's what it looks like in-game![/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43801174/a7ce1bc55e8dfbcfb1a98bfda183a092ea3fcf4f.png[/img]
If you've never tried an acai bowl before I highly recommend it! I prefer it with coconut water personally~ Oh and it's also much cheaper to make it at home than if you buy it at a cafe ;p ($17 is theft!!) 

That's it for now! Oh boy, it's gonna be Christmas soon...how did the year go by so fast (Ｔ▽Ｔ) ...anyways I'll be back soon and share any updates or changes from the first wave of demo players.

[b]I hope you get to check out the demo sometime! Bye-bye~ ❤️

notes.title: #5 - PAX Photos, BETA Signup, and More! 🎮 🎉
notes.notes:
[b]Hi folks and welcome back to the [i]Diets and Deities[/i] Steam News Update! [/b] Whether you've never heard about Diets and Deities before or you're familiar with our project, thanks for dropping by! 💞

[b][url=https://dietsanddeities.com/]Diets and Deities[/url] is an upcoming PC rhythm cooking game developed in Darwin, NT! Discover the music and recipes from diverse cultures as you dodge to the beat and uncover the flavours of the universe![/b] I'm Skye 👋 the concept artist and community manager for Dieits and Deities! 

There's a lot to through this month so let's go! It's been a hectic few months between preparing the build and marketing assets for PAX, to the back-to-back networking and learning conferences! [b]Needless to say, our social batteries are still collectively out of charge! But the show goes on and I'm super excited to share lots of photos and talk about how the week went! FYI this is going to be a long newsletter, so apologies in advance![/b]

[i]Me trying to absorb information from panels after 5 days of conferences and networking in a row...
[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43801174/fee75993d020466eaff75c6de102bcbbc28cf3bd.gif[/img]

[h2]Melbourne International Games Week![/h2]
So to explain, a few weeks ago we attended [b][url=https://gamesweek.melbourne/]Melbourne International Games Week[/url][/b], a jampacked week filled with lots of amazing events for the game industry!  

[b]And this year was a particularly important and amazing moment for the Northern Territory! As an industry, we've come so far![/b] Last year we had only 3 people (myself included!) but this year we had over 13 people attend who showed off their work, connected with fellow game developers, and represented our small but passionate community!

Some context for those who might've missed last month's newsletter, we showcased [b][url=https://dietsanddeities.com/]Diets and Deities[/url][/b] at PAX AUS 2023! 

[b]We’re also the very first game from the Northern Territory to be showcased at PAX!! Alongside the game, we hoped to find some beta testers for our upcoming push to beta release![/b]

[h2]🎵 High Score 🎵[/h2]
[b][url=https://www.apraamcos.com.au/about/supporting-the-industry/programs/high-score]High Score[/url] [/b]is a hybrid in-person and live-streamed conference exploring the important role that music and audio play in game design and experience!

[b]Our musician TUTUP MULUT and local NT artist Serina Pech had a great time learning from so many inspiring creatives in their profession![/b]As someone who very much isn't a musician, it was amazing to absorb really interesting knowledge on music within games!

[b]Thank you so much to [url=https://creative.gov.au/]Creative Australia[/url] for making this trip possible![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43801174/3212a0394fd5b1a6bd593471c66d3058764d743c.jpg[/img]
[h2]👋 GCAP 👋[/h2]
[b][url=https://gcap.com.au/]Games Connect Asia Pacific (GCAP)[/url][/b] is a professional development and networking event for the Australian game development industry, focused on up-skilling and connecting through education and knowledge sharing!

There were so many great panels to attend this year it was so hard to choose every day! It was so much fun to have so many friends there with us for the 3 days of learning!

[b]Thank you so much to [b][url=https://igea.net/]IGEA[/url] and [url=https://screenterritory.nt.gov.au/]Screen Territory[/url][/b] for supporting our Territorians at GCAP![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43801174/34bea41c6901525490875116bae32ebb24b3383f.jpg[/img]
[b]Dylan Bennett, the director of Larrikin Interactive (our studio!) also got to present a talk on the story of how he started the game development scene in the NT![/b] He has worked so hard to get to this point and I'm so glad the NT got represented at GCAP! [b]Dylan is the very reason we've been part of the amazing journey that you've been reading about! ❤️[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43801174/bffed42bb83438a6c543c6ba6070a4f8457269c6.jpg[/img]
[h2]🎉 AGDAs 🎉[/h2]
We also all attended the [url=https://agdas.com.au/][b]Australian Game Developer Awards (AGDAs)[/b][/url], the Australian games industry’s night of nights to celebrate the outstanding games and individual achievements of the Australian game development community!

[b]AND VERY IMPORTANTLY!! A very special congratulations to our amazing boss and inspiration, Dylan Bennett who won the Empower Award!! ✨ 💕

Dylan is both the spark and superglue that holds our passionate game development community together in the NT. Everyone on the team is so proud of all of his hard work over the past 2 years to reach this monumental milestone![/b]

It really feels like the NT is finally now on the map in the Australian game industry! Thank you so much for all of your hard work!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43801174/60601a73c76935aa92c2948472c03c97730f66aa.jpg[/img]

Here's a photos of our amazing team and the incredible people behind the scenes all in fancy dress!

[h2]🎮 PAX 🎮[/h2]

notes.title: #3 - Visual Update and How We Concept Level Art! 🖼️✨
notes.notes:
[b]Hi folks and welcome back to the newsletter! [/b]

Whether you've never heard about Diets and Deities before or you're familiar with our project, thanks for dropping by! 💞

[b][url=https://dietsanddeities.com/]Diets and Deities[/url] is an upcoming PC rhythm cooking game developed in Darwin, NT! Discover the music and recipes from diverse cultures as you dodge to the beat and uncover the flavours of the universe![/b]

I'm Skye 👋 the concept artist and community manager for Dieits and Deities! We've got a lot to cover this month so let's go!

[i]Let's get into it![/i]

[h2]✨ Visual Update ✨[/h2]
[b]Over the past few weeks, we've done a massive update on our game's visuals![/b] It looks pretty different from when you last saw it! Check out this before and after! 🙌

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43801174/89119e763cec9e36b11d9b05a98943b731b8abf4.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43801174/593a3a1dfc2b804643f45cfb7acee192cfcd8209.gif[/img]

[b]Here's what's new: [/b]

[b]1. Note designs - [/b]These new notes reflect the characters' culture, design, and personality. As the level progresses, the notes change and grow!

[b]2. Idle Animations -[/b] Our main character, Nephele, now has a selection of new unique animations (check her out wielding that rolling pin)!

[b]3. Attack Animations - [/b]Each enemy has a special animation when notes fall down (keep an eye out for the other characters' attacks in future updates!)

[b]4. Progress Bar -[/b] Keep collecting notes to fill out the bar to successfully complete the level!

[b]5. Enemies Move on Beat - [/b]Your culinary opponent will move to where the notes spawn. We felt that it helped the player anticipate what's coming and added to the enemy's agency in the fight!

Thanks so much to our incredibly talented artists Sam and Manu for all of their hard work and dedication to the project. They've really made a world of difference! 💗✨

[b]We're still very much polishing our game, so expect to see more changes over the next few months![/b]

[b]We're also making content![/b] You can check out our socials here:
🍦[url=https://www.youtube.com/@DietsnDeities/featured]Youtube[/url]
🧇 [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@dietsanddeities]TikTok[/url]

[h2]🌟How We Concept Level Art🌟[/h2]
So I'm actually the concept artist behind all of the level art you see in the game!🥳✨

Like a lot of us on the team, this was a completely new experience for me, so my design process might not be the same for others! I just thought it would be fun to share how our levels go from idea to final.

[i]Let's check out Barong's level design![/i]

[b]Stage 1: Ideas[/b]
I started out with a moodboard with these considerations in mind:
- What is the natural landscape of Indonesia? How can I showcase a region in a few images?
- What kind of visual storytelling do we want to convey? Should we depict temples, beaches, islands, etc.
- What are the important cultural symbols or environments to capture and represent?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43801174/cab10fef9b4b121515e72009857ee174edd9e2b5.png[/img]

[b]Stage 2: Thumbnails[/b]
Based on my moodboard I create some quick thumbnails! I try to simplify shapes with the goal of capturing the landscape. I'm also looking specifically for how the player might progress to each level.

I also make a lot of different iterations. I want to give our level artist the ability to create the best artworks possible without too much guesswork and uncertainty!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43801174/15e460910326fa803a1286bb79e619f807c62484.png[/img]

[b]Stage 3: Concepts[/b]
After I create a selection of thumbnails, the team and I start to decide which ideas we like best. At this point, I also alter the artworks to best represent the level scene where necessary.

Here are the designs we decided on as well as my inspiration and references!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43801174/8dabb5271e3c4d116143712af60f9626d7753677.png[/img]

[b]Stage 4: Level Art[/b]
Now I hand off the concepts to our level artist, Manu! Similar to any other drawing process, Manu gradually adds more detail or lighting to eventually create the final artwork! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43801174/adaad90f243e59ef9bf40c6a0b7a7c3b32132785.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43801174/65820977b2825d91552a5bc6d9848c8e7bb2f587.png[/img]
[i]And Tada! ✨[/i]

[b]We have 4 areas in the game (with a total of 16 levels)! [/b]With each new area, we all gain so much valuable information and insight into the design process. I hope you enjoyed that lil sneak peek!

[b]That's it for this month! But before you go...
We'll leave you here with this amazing Balinese recipe! 🧑‍🍳[/b]

[h2] Enjoy A Balinese Recipe 🍽️[/h2]
[h3] Tempe Manis [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43801174/999fefb2bb3f18926d58e7870bda7d9c99f88647.png[/img]

[b]Ingredients:[/b]
[list]
[*] 2 blocks of tempe
[*] 10 garlic cloves
[*] 4 Shallots
[*] 250ml of Coconut oil
[*] 100ml Kecap Manis
[/list]
[b]Method:[/b]
[olist]
[*] Chop tempe into bite sized rectangles.
[*] Heat oil in a deep pan.
[*] Put tempe into hot oil and cook until golden brown.
[*] Remove tempe from the oil and place on paper towel or rack to dry and turn the heat off.
[*] Finely chop the garlic and shallots.
[*] Place in a hot pan with some of the oil used for frying the tempe.
[*] Fry until light brown then add kecap manis.
[*] Add the deep fried tempe to the pan and toss until all the tempe is coated in sauce.
[*] Plate and serve with rice.
[/olist]

[b]Thanks to amazing music producer, Liam, for recommending this recipe from [url=https://lifestyle.okezone.com/read/2020/04/11/298/2197746/cara-membuat-kering-tempe-manis-seperti-buatan-ibu]Oke Lifestyle[/url]![/b]

[h3]Ayam Kuning [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43801174/5b8afa7cb90bf0a647adc4b081188ede4dfa7631.jpg[/img]

[b]Ingredients:[/b]
[list]
[*] 1.5 kilos of chicken wings
[*] 6 chillies
[*] 5 shallots
[*] 5 cloves garlic
[*] 2cm Galangal
[*] 2cm Ginger
[*] 2cm Turmeric
[*] 10 Candlenuts (can be replaced with 1/2 cup coconut milk)
[*] Salt to taste
[*] Pepper to taste
[*] 1/2 teaspoon of MSG
[*] 1/2 teaspoon of shrimp paste
[*] 2 thick pieces of lemon grass
[*] 2 Bay leaves
[*] 3tbsp of Coconut oil
[/list]
[b]Method:[/b]
[olist]
[*] Wash the chicken.
[*] Heat coconut oil in large pan and fry chicken until golden brown.
[*] Set chicken aside on rack or paper towel to dry and turn the heat off.
[*] Combine the chillies, garlic, shallots, galangal, ginger, turmeric, candlenuts, 1 piece of lemon grass, salt, pepper and msg in a mortar and pestle and grind into a paste. Alternatively, you can use a food processor.
[*] Add the paste to the same pan used for the chicken and fry on low heat for 3 minutes.
[*] Add your chicken back into the pan with the bay leaves, lemon grass stalk and 2 cups of water.
[*] Bring to boil then Reduce the heat and place on the lid to simmer for 30 minutes.
[*] Plate and serve with rice.
[/olist]
[b]Thanks to amazing music producer, Liam, for recommending this recipe from [url=https://www.bbcgoodfood.com/recipes/balinese-chicken-satay]BBC Good Foods[/url]![/b]

[b]Hi folks and welcome to the [i]Diets and Deities[/i] Steam News Update! 🥳🎉[/b]

[h2] Enjoy A Balinese Recipe 🍽️[/h2]
[h3]Balinese Chicken Satay [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43801174/3b318943e464e5bac624d323d72077b29691ad80.jpg[/img]

[b]Ingredients:[/b]
[list]
[*] 3 shallots
[*] 3 or 4 garlic cloves
[*] 25g root ginger, peeled
[*] 2 small red or 1 large plump red chilli
[*] 1 tbsp vegetable or groundnut oil
[*] ½ tsp each ground turmeric, ground white pepper and ground coriander
[*] ¼ tsp ground nutmeg
[*] Pinch ground cloves
[*] 500g pkt minced chicken (or lamb)
[*] 2 fresh (or freeze dried) lime leaves, cut into fine strips with scissors
[*] 1 tbsp unsweetened desiccated coconut or 25g/1oz block creamed coconut, grated
[*] To serve 12 lemongrass stalks (or wooden skewers)
[*] Banana leaves, optional
[/list]
[b]Method:[/b]
[olist]
[*] Thinly slice then finely chop the shallots, garlic and ginger. Now finely chop the chilli, including the seeds. This amount of chilli gives a spicy but not too fiery kick to the chicken satay, but discard the seeds if you don’t like the heat.
[*] Heat the oil in a frying pan over a low heat. Add the shallots, garlic, ginger and chillies and fry for 1-2 minutes just to soften. Pour in a couple of tablespoons of water to soften, then stir in the spices (and freeze-dried lime leaves, if using) and fry for a minute.
[*] Remove the pan from the heat, let the mixture cool down, then blend to a paste with a pestle and mortar, using an up-and-down motion with the pestle. It will take several minutes to make a soft paste.
[*] Mix the spice paste, the coconut and, if using, the shredded fresh lime leaves with the minced chicken. Season with salt.
[*] Break off pieces of the mixture the size of a large walnut. For each, flatten into a round and lay a lemongrass stalk or wooden skewer in the centre. Mould around the bulbous end of the stalk (or skewer), working it so it goes about 8cm up it.
[*] Rough up the surface a little with your fingers so that the meat is not completely smooth and has some texture, then set aside while you shape the rest of the skewers. Brush each skewer with extra oil.
[*] Cook the skewers on a preheated BBQ, griddle pan or grill for 8-10 minutes, turning several times. Serve on banana leaves
[/olist]
